text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install three all-way stop controls on Sunnyside Avenue at Constance Street, at Grenadier Road and at Westminster Avenue to enhance safety for pedestrians, cyclists and motorists using these intersections. The installation of the all-way stop sign control is technically warranted and will enhance operational safety at these intersections.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Sunnyside Avenue at Constance Street. 2. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Sunnyside Avenue at Grenadier Road. 3. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Sunnyside Avenue and Westminster Avenue.
